ITEM 1 | Pale yellow, soft, crumbly scrambled mass with small curds and slight darker golden edges, matte surface with no visible sheen, forming a loose heap about 13 cm long and 8 cm wide, roughly 2 to 3 cm high, occupying the lower-left portion of the white square plate, with a few small loose crumbs scattered at its edge | 130

ITEM 2 | Dark green wilted leafy greens with glossy, slightly wet sheen, leaves folded and clumped, interspersed with thin orange shredded strips (about 4 to 6 cm long, 0.3 cm wide) and a few pale green stem pieces, forming a diagonal heap about 12 cm long and 6 cm wide, roughly 2 cm high, sitting on the upper-right portion of the plate beside the scrambled mass | 75
